owner_request.summary: After the v0.16.0 release: pre-register v0.17.0. Standing rules unchanged: push after every step; no force-push; never edit frozen or ledger-hashed files; no GitHub Actions and no workflows; evidence labels Exact / Observed / Simulated / Inferred / Rejected / Open; host-agnostic embeddable core API; do not touch brute-bridge or BGR-v0.90.0; publish whatever happens.

breadth_decision.decision: DEPTH headline plus a BREADTH block. Headline: recover the coverage the v0.16.0 tolerant region lost, without weakening its soundness bound, by replacing the single worst-case flip budget m with a sequential boundary m(b). Breadth block: the first larger alphabet (3 actions, 2-bit readings).
reasons: v0.16.0 GNS failed on usefulness only: RGN4 was sound (0 false in 240 noisy cases, CP95 0.0124) but C at eps 0.02 was 0.066 [0.051, 0.081] (Observed, GATES_018). Leaving that failure unaddressed would make every later noisy study inherit a near-useless certifier.
The oracle arm RGN4_or (m = realized flips) reached C 0.316 at eps 0.02 with 0 false (Observed), so the loss is in the margin, not in the region.

A certificate at step t depends only on readings up to t, so the margin needs to cover only the flips seen so far; a boundary on the running flip count keeps the same per-case delta (Exact lemma below).
Larger alphabets were deferred from v0.16.0; a 3-action block at modest size tests whether the region machinery and its soundness carry over without changing the headline question.
breadth_decision.label: Inferred (design judgement, recorded before any v0.17.0 code or data exists)

noise_model.definition: as study-018: each OBSERVED (unmasked) bit of every reading, including the initial one, is flipped independently with probability eps; masked bits are unaffected; actions are noise-free; the latent reading is the scoring truth.
noise_model.attested_bound: eps_bar = 0.02 (caller attestation); eps5_stress is outside it and has no guarantee.
noise_model.flip_rng: numpy.random.default_rng([target_seed, round(1000*eps), 19]) drawn after the mask; realized flips per case and per prefix recorded (Exact count).
noise_model.label: Simulated (synthetic iid noise)

sequential_margin.RGNB_n: RGN_n with the single cardinality constraint sum(flips) <= m replaced, at step t, by sum(flips over the observed bits of readings 0..t) <= m(b_t), where b_t is the number of observed bits in readings 0..t and m(.) is the boundary below; certification rule as RGN (region singleton after burn-in 8, no SP8 passthrough; SAT UNKNOWN counts as possible; infeasible certifies nothing).
sequential_margin.boundary: Observed bits are ordered reading by reading (reading 0 first, bit 0 before bit 1). Given B (observed bits over all 45 readings, fixed by the mask before the first action), eps_bar and delta = 0.01: m(0) = 0; for b = 1..B, m(b) is the smallest integer >= m(b-1) such that the probability, under iid Bernoulli(eps_bar) flips, that the running flip count has exceeded the boundary at some bit <= b is at most delta * b / B (linear alpha spending), computed by an exact dynamic program over the running count with fractions.Fraction.

boundary_examples_Exact.B=46: m = 1 from bit 1, 2 from bit 3, 3 from bit 15, 4 from bit 38 (total crossing probability 0.00848)
boundary_examples_Exact.B=58: m = 1 from bit 1, 2 from bit 2, 3 from bit 14, 4 from bit 35 (0.00970)
boundary_examples_Exact.B=68: m = 1 from bit 1, 2 from bit 2, 3 from bit 13, 4 from bit 33, 5 from bit 57 (0.00871)
boundary_examples_Exact.vs_fixed_m: final m(B) equals the study-018 fixed m for B in 44-58 and 66-70, and is one larger for B = 40-42 and 60-64

sequential_margin.lemma_conditional_Exact: If the running flip count never exceeds m(b) on a trajectory and the true machine has <= n states, the true machine is in RGNB_n at every step, so every RGNB_n certificate equals the latent reading.
sequential_margin.bound_unconditional: Under the noise model with eps <= eps_bar, P(case has any false RGNB4 certificate) <= P(boundary crossed) <= delta = 0.01 per case (Exact as a probability statement under the model; Simulated with respect to real noise).
sequential_margin.label: Exact conditional on (no crossing, n* <= FB); probabilistic (<= delta per case) unconditionally under the iid model

GNB_sequential_margin.threshold: HEADLINE. RGNB4 on the 240 noisy main cases (eps 0.01 and 0.02): (a) 0 false certificates on every case without a boundary crossing; AND (b) Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound of the case-false rate <= 0.05; AND (c) dC = C(RGNB4) - C(RGN4) at eps = 0.02 with seed-clustered paired CI lower > 0; AND (d) mean C(RGNB4) at eps = 0.02 >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0.05 (the study-018 bar, unchanged).
